C remains untouched and B remains held.

retrospective.summary: Completed Unit B scoped multi-path CLI runtime with a derived safety gate: total input normalization, persisted topology, restart and lifecycle refusals, pre-mutation startup serialization, truthful background startup, infrastructure/content policy boundaries, TypeScript capability refusal, and focused plus full validation. Independent review found only the two deliberately deferred Unit C aggregate surfaces, confirming the stack merge constraint.
